children.html: Home / Uncategorized / First Time Shopping at our Marlton Dispensary? Discover South Jersey's Best Dispensary Deals

Welcome to Highway 90, your go-to destination for premium cannabis products and unbeatable deals! Whether you’re a first-time customer or a seasoned enthusiast, we’ve designed our dispensary experience to be easy, welcoming, and rewarding. In this guide, we’ll walk you through everything you need to know about shopping with us, how our process works, and most importantly, the best ways to save on your favorite products.

Best Ways to Save at Highway 90

At Highway 90, we’re committed to offering our customers the best prices, discounts, and rewards. Here’s a breakdown of how you can maximize your savings:

First-Time Visitors: Exclusive Deals Just for You

We love welcoming new customers to the Highway 90 family! To make your first visit even sweeter, we offer special discounts on your first few orders. Here’s how it works:

  • 15% OFF your first order
  • 20% OFF your second order
  • 25% OFF your third order

That’s right, you can save up to 25% just by being a first-time customer. This is our way of saying thank you for choosing our Marlton dispensary!

Weekly Fresh Deals: New Specials Every Week

We believe in keeping things fresh, and that includes our deals! Each week, we drop new specials across a variety of brands and product categories. Make sure to check in regularly so you never miss out on limited-time discounts and promotions.

Daily Discounts: Extra Savings Every Day

We offer daily discounts for specific groups to ensure everyone gets a fair deal. Here’s what we offer:

  • Seniors (65+): Get 10% OFF your purchase
  • Industry Workers (any state with proof): Save 15% OFF
  • Veterans: Receive 15% OFF
  • Medical Card Holders (any state with proof): Enjoy 10% OFF

These discounts apply every day, so be sure to bring your ID and any relevant documentation to save even more!

Celebrate Your Birthday with Us, Get a Free Pre-Roll!

At Highway 90, we love celebrating your special day! To make your birthday even better, we’re offering one FREE Pete’s Pre-Roll with any purchase on your birthday. It’s our way of saying thank you for choosing us to be part of your celebrations! Pre-Roll selection may vary while supplies last.

Rewards That Add Up: Earn Points and Save

Our rewards program is one of the best ways to earn while you shop. Signing up is free, and for every dollar you spend, you’ll earn 1 point. Once you reach 100 points, you’ll get $5 off your next purchase. Not a rewards member? Sign up Now!

Want to take your rewards to the next level? Upgrade to our VIP program! For just $12/month or $100/year, you’ll unlock:

  • 100 bonus points every month
  • One 25% off coupon every month
  • One 10% off coupon every month
  • 1.5 loyalty points for every dollar spent

With these perks, you’ll earn rewards faster and save even more on your favorite products! Download the Highway 90 app today to become a VIP!

Important Reminder: Discount Application at Checkout

Please remember that all deals and discounts will be applied at the register. If you don’t see a discount applied, don’t hesitate to ask your budtender for help. Note that discounts can’t be stacked, but we’ll always ensure you get the best deal available!

How to Shop at Highway 90 Dispensary

Shopping at Highway 90 is straightforward and stress-free. Whether you’re a first-time visitor or a regular customer, we’ve designed the process to be easy, efficient, and enjoyable.

Pre-Order or Browse In-Store

Not sure where to start? No worries! You can choose to either pre-order online for a quick pickup or come in-store to browse our selection with the help of one of our friendly, knowledgeable budtenders. At Highway 90, we don’t use kiosks – instead, you’ll have the opportunity to engage with a budtender 1-on-1. They’re here to help answer any questions, guide you through our products, and offer recommendations based on your preferences.

We accept cash, debit & credit payments through the Highway 90 app, Dutchie Pay, and have on-site ATMs for your convenience.

Order Through the Highway 90 App

If you prefer shopping from the comfort of your own home, the Highway 90 app is the way to go. Download the app today and you’ll be rewarded with 100 bonus loyalty points just for signing up. The app allows you to shop our menu, place orders, check out exclusive specials, and view your loyalty points – all in one place.

The app also allows you to refer a friend and earn rewards! Simply click the “Refer a Friend” button in the app, send your unique referral link to friends, and when they make a purchase they’ll receive 50 bonus loyalty points, and you’ll get a FREE 1g pre-roll. The best part? You can refer as many friends as you’d like!

Download the Highway 90 App today in the Apple app store or Google Play.

Frequently Asked Questions

Who Can Shop at Highway 90?
Cannabis is legal in New Jersey for adults aged 21 and older. Highway 90 is a recreational dispensary, but we also offer a 10% discount for medical patients from any state with proof of medical ID.

What Can You Buy at Highway 90?
We offer a wide range of premium cannabis products, including:

    • Flower
    • Edibles
    • Concentrates
    • Vapes
    • Pre-Rolls
    • And more!

All of our products undergo rigorous testing to ensure they meet the highest quality and safety standards. New Jersey has specific purchasing limits, which include:

  • 1 ounce of flower
  • 4 grams of concentrates, oils, or vapes
  • 1,000 mg of edibles

You can also mix and match these products, as long as your total doesn’t exceed the NJ state limit.

How Can I Pay for My Order?
Due to current banking restrictions in New Jersey, debit and credit cards may not always be accepted. However, we gladly accept cash, Dutchie Pay, payments via the Highway 90 app using credit or debit cards, or ATM withdrawals on-site.

What are Highway 90’s Store Hours?

Our store hours are Monday-Saturday 9am-10pm and Sunday 9am-7pm. We’re open every day, and we’re here to help you find the perfect products for your needs. Hours are subject to change on Holidays or due to inclement weather.

What’s the difference between recreational and medical cannabis?

As a recreational dispensary, our cannabis products are available to all adults 21 and over with valid ID, while medical cannabis is specifically for patients with qualifying conditions who hold a valid medical marijuana card. At Highway 90, we offer 10% off for medical patients from any state with valid and up to date proof of their medical marijuana card.

How do I know what products are best for me?

If you’re unsure where to start, our experienced budtenders are here to help. They can guide you based on your preferences and what you’re looking for – whether that’s energy, relaxation, pain relief, sleep, or something else! Just ask, and our staff will be more than happy to assist you.

Does Highway 90 carry CBD products?

Yes! We carry a variety of CBD products, including tinctures, edibles, and topicals. Our budtenders can help you choose the best product for your needs.

How do I redeem my rewards points?

You can redeem your rewards points for discounts on your purchases once you reach 100 points. For every dollar spent, you earn 1 point, and once you reach 100, you’ll get $5 off your next order. You can check your points balance through our Highway 90 app or ask our budtenders for an update. Our budtenders can also tell you at the register how many points you have, and will always ask if you want to apply your available rewards to your purchase.

Can I return or exchange products?

All sales are final. No exchanges or returns unless defective. Defective products will only be exchanged within 7 days of purchase. You must provide the original packaging and product, as well as your receipt.

How Can I Make the Most of My Visit to Highway 90?

Come with an open mind and any questions you may have! Whether you’re here for your first time or you’re a regular, our friendly budtenders are ready to guide you to the perfect products. At Highway 90 Dispensary, we’re all about good vibes and helping you discover exactly what you need to elevate your experience. So, let’s make it a great visit – we’ve got the best products and deals waiting for you!

Stay in the Loop With the Hottest Daily Deals

Want to stay updated on our latest specials and product drops? Join our rewards program today and get notified about the hottest deals and newest arrivals at Highway 90. You won’t want to miss out on our exclusive offers!

Come check out Highway 90 and see for yourself why we’re Marlton’s favorite dispensary!
